about.heroSubtitle: Bilingual English–Vietnamese educator specializing in Science, Physics, ESL, and IELTS. Experience with Swinburne University, Canadian STEM Program, and Martin Academy.
about.educatorDescription: Bilingual English–Vietnamese educator specializing in Science, Physics, ESL, and IELTS. Experience with Swinburne University, Canadian STEM Program, and Martin Academy.
about.tesolDesc: Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages
about.visionText: To be the world's most trusted multilingual learning platform, where students from all backgrounds can achieve their educational goals through innovative and engaging content.
about.storyTitle: From a Love of Learning to a Desire to Share
about.storyP1: SkyAcademy began in Da Nang in 2025 — with one dedicated young educator. Self-driven, diligent, and eager to learn, she reached a strong level in language and then chose to teach others. That desire to bring quality language education to as many learners as possible gave birth to SkyAcademy.
about.storyP2: From small classes in Da Nang, SkyAcademy has grown into an online language learning platform, supporting thousands of students across Vietnam and beyond.
about.storyP3: Today, we continue to innovate and expand our offerings, always keeping our students' success at the heart of everything we do.

about.valuePassionDesc: Teaching is our calling, and we love what we do
about.valueInnovationDesc: Always improving and adapting our methods

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At SkyAcademy, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data.

infoCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
infoCollect.desc: We collect information you provide directly to us when you register for courses, purchase books, submit homework, or contact us for support.
items: Personal identification (name, email, phone number)
Course registration and enrollment information
Payment and billing information
Homework submissions and related files
Communication history with our support team

howUse.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
howUse.desc: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process your course registrations and book purchases, and communicate with you.
items: Process course registrations and book orders
Verify payments and provide access to purchased content
Send course updates and important notifications
Respond to your inquiries and provide customer support
Improve our website and services based on usage patterns

dataSecurity.title: 3. Data Security
dataSecurity.desc: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
items: SSL/TLS encryption for data transmission
Secure storage of personal information
Regular security reviews and updates
Limited access to personal data on a need-to-know basis
Secure handling of payment information

yourRights.title: 4. Your Rights
yourRights.desc: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time by contacting us directly.
items: Access your personal data we hold
Request correction of inaccurate information
Request deletion of your personal data
Opt-out of marketing communications
Withdraw consent for data processing where applicable

cookies.title: 5. Cookies & Tracking
cookies.desc: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience and analyze website traffic.
items: Essential cookies for site functionality
Analytics cookies to improve our services
Preference cookies to remember your settings
Marketing cookies (with your consent)
You can manage cookie preferences anytime

contactUs.title: 6. Contact Us
contactUs.desc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us.
items: Email: skyacademy210@gmail.com
Location: Da Nang, Vietnam
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/skyacademy0/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@skyacademy0

privacyPolicy.privacyMattersDesc: We regularly review and update our privacy practices to ensure your data remains protected. If you have any concerns or questions, please don't hesitate to contact us.
